title: My English Book 6
header: Builds "My English Book 6" – sixth-grade English syllabus – A4 portrait.
csub: Past • Advice • Adverbs • Whose? • Hobbies • Time • Stories
noteP: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ يُكْمِلُ تَعْلِيمَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ: الأَفْعَالُ الشَّاذَّةُ فِي المَاضِي، وَالنَّصِيحَةُ بِـ should، وَالأَحْوَالُ (slowly)، وَضَمَائِرُ المِلْكِيَّةِ (mine)، وَالهِوَايَاتُ، وَحُرُوفُ الجَرِّ لِلزَّمَنِ، مَعَ قِصَّتَيْنِ 🇬🇧
noteLi: فِي كُلِّ دَرْسٍ مَسَاحَةٌ لِيَكْتُبَ طِفْلُكُمْ جُمْلَةً إِنْجِلِيزِيَّةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ.
اسْأَلُوهُ عَنْ يَوْمِهِ بِالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ: What did you do yesterday?
اطْلُبُوا مِنْهُ نَصِيحَةً صِحِّيَّةً: You should …
الكِتَابُ يُقْرَأُ مِنَ اليَسَارِ إِلَى اليَمِينِ.
blurb: A complete 3D English book with a brand-new design – part 6, with Arabic meanings for every word.
blurbLi: Giving advice with should and adverbs (-ly)
mine, yours, his, hers and hobbies with -ing
in, on, at for time, and two short stories
en2: كِتَابٌ شَامِلٌ بِتَصْمِيمٍ جَدِيدٍ لِتَعْلِيمِ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ – الجُزْءُ السَّادِسُ

units.title: Irregular Past Verbs
units.intro: Some verbs do not take -ed in the past. We learn them by heart.
items: Yesterday, I went to the park with my family.
She went to school by bus.
We ate dates and rice for lunch.
I saw a big yellow flower in the garden.
Ali wrote a letter to his grandpa.

acts.title: Choose the past
rows: She ... a rainbow after the rain.
He ... his name on the board.

acts.title: Did you …?
rows: Did you go to school yesterday? Yes, I ...
Did she eat breakfast? No, she ...
... you see the moon last night?

units.title: Stay Healthy
units.intro: We use should and shouldn't to give advice.
items: You should sleep early every night.
You should eat vegetables every day.
You shouldn't eat too many sweets.
You should drink a lot of water.
You shouldn't drink too much soda.

acts.title: should or shouldn't?
rows: You ... brush your teeth twice a day.
You ... wash your hands before meals.

acts.title: True or false?
acts.hint: Tick ✓ for true and ✗ for false
rows: Fruit is good for our health.

units.title: How Do They Move?
units.intro: Adverbs tell us how we do something. Many adverbs end in -ly.
items: The race car moves very quickly.

acts.title: Complete the sentence
rows: We should read ... in the library.

units.title: Whose Is It?
units.intro: We use mine, yours, his and hers to show who owns something.
items: This is my bag. It's mine.
This is Omar's book. It's his.
This is Sara's pen. It's hers.

acts.title: Whose is it?
rows: Is this pen ...? Yes, it's mine.

units.title: My Hobbies
units.intro: After like and love, we add -ing to the verb.
items: I like swimming in the sea.

units.title: In, On or At?
units.intro: We use at, on and in with times, days, months and seasons.
items: I go to school at seven o'clock.
We go to the mosque early on Friday.
It is very hot in summer.

units.title: Reading Time
units.intro: Read the stories, then answer the questions.

acts.title: A Visit to Grandpa
acts.html:
A Visit to Grandpa 👴

Last Friday, Sara and her brother Ali visited their grandpa.
They went by car.
Grandpa told them a story about the old days.
They ate dates and drank milk.
Before they left, Grandpa gave them a big hug.

acts.title: The Lost Wallet
acts.html:
The Lost Wallet 👛

Yusuf found a wallet in the park.
There was a lot of money in it.
He didn't keep it. He took it to the police station.
The owner was very happy and thanked him.
Yusuf felt proud because he was honest.

acts.title: Answer
rows: Where did Yusuf find the wallet?
What did he do with it?
He took it to the police.
